# Independent audit: invariant buffer selects one of two deepest interval bases

Sources read in full:

* `candidate 1298c8ea2c6ec3df`;
* its exact ordinary-depth dependency `candidate 75dd33535e246a34`.


counterexample for the specified buffer, not an OC counterexample.

The convex endpoint roofs and all four fiber lengths check. The complete
piecewise-affine slope tables certify both orientations at each ordinary
marked source, and the closed pure-base masses are retained. Tightening
one of the paired caps at every other inner mark proves the exact ordinary
maximizer set; exposed-base isolation handles both outer fibers.

The covariance is the WITHIN-fiber covariance, with no between-centroid
term. Its exact value and the interval projective energy formulas agree
with direct integrations. The buffered threshold shift therefore has the
correct factor epsilon*sqrt(Sigma/M)*sqrt(E).

At each original deepest mark, every nonvertical cap gains exactly delta
in its proper own trace and nonnegative mass elsewhere. The displayed
critical caps preserve all their other full/empty statuses and attain the
matching upper bound. Pure-base caps have a strict larger mass.

The all-source proof is uniform: every interval changes any cap mass by
at most delta_max; the four-source error is at most 4 delta_max. The fixed
eta-tightened caps give the exact Q-eta bound outside the two inner
neighborhoods. Within them the appropriate two fixed-normal caps give
Q-|y|+delta_i(y), whose delta derivative has magnitude strictly below one.
Thus neither shifted inner marks nor other bases can overtake the two
stated mark values. E1>E2 then gives the unique positive-buffer winner
for the entire stated epsilon interval, however small epsilon is.

The resultant sign also checks: E1'(0)/(2E1)=-1/22, hence delta1'=-delta1/22.
With u_plus=1/sqrt(Sigma) and u_minus its negative, the listed rho weights
produce epsilon*f'(0), and coarea normalization makes the actual response
weights equal rho. The same actual noncentral source has projective
parameter -1/22.

Independently reran the two exact verifiers. They pass 3,050 and 512 checks,
respectively. The analytic all-normal proof relies on the COMPLETE finite
breakpoint lists and the uniform status margins, not on numerical sampling.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
